## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

Three fascicles of an anonymous Tang-period commentary on the *Sìfēn prātimokṣa*, preserved in **Dunhuang** manuscript form and included in volume 85 of the Taishō *Gǔyìbù* 古逸部.

**Abstract**

The Dunhuang library cave preserved numerous Tang-period commentary fragments on the *Sìfēn lǜ* and its *prātimokṣa* — testimony to the active Vinaya scholarship at Dunhuang and other northwestern Chinese Buddhist centres in the late-Tang period. This three-fascicle fragment is one such commentary, complementing the major canonical commentaries ([道宣](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E5%AE%A3) Dàoxuān, [懷素](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%87%B7%E7%B4%A0) Huáisù, [定賓](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%9A%E8%B3%93) Dìng Bīn) and providing evidence for the diversity of *Sìfēn* exegetical traditions in mid-late Tang Buddhism. [KR6k0134](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0134)–0142 are similar Dunhuang Vinaya commentary fragments.
